packages.name: VIP Bronze
packages.description:
Your monthly CnC membership:

  • $50,000 bank money every month (claim it in game: F5 → My purchases)
  • Bronze VIP tag in chat and on the player list
  • VIP Bronze role on our Discord
  • Ahead of players without VIP in the queue when the server is full

Renews monthly. Cancel anytime from your Tebex payment history; perks stay until the paid month ends.
